children: Zoomcar advanced its private placement by entering securities purchase agreements for a fifth closing, selling 80 Series A Units for $80,000 in total consideration, including $20,000 in cash and $60,000 via debt settlement. Each Unit includes one Series A Convertible Preferred Share and a warrant for 20,000 common shares; preferred shares convert at $0.05 and warrants are exercisable at $0.0625 for five years. The overall offering targets up to $5 million, plus a $5 million overallotment option. Zoomcar also executed a registration rights agreement, committing to file a resale registration statement within 15 days to enhance investor liquidity.
